format: InfinityDB expanded non-catalog battlefield element reviews
scope: audit-only; excludes publication, inferred object profiles, carriers and delivery

reviews.summaryEvidence: A Marker is a game element with Attributes represented by a Marker
reviews.caveat: The glossary describes an on-table representation, not a concrete new Weapon/Equipment profile. Resolve the represented source element separately.

factsEvidence: Place one Console at the center of each of the four scoring Quadrants
Represent each Console with a Console A Marker or scenery of the same diameter.
reviews.caveat: The four Console objectives are Domination scenario elements represented by markers or scenery, not catalog Weapon/Equipment Deployables. Maintain scenario geometry and Hack Consoles separately.

factsEvidence: Place three Supply Boxes: one at the center of the table
Represent each Supply Box with a Supply Box Marker or a similar scenery item.
reviews.caveat: The three Supply Boxes are Supplies scenario objectives, not Army-carried Weapon/Equipment object identities. Their placement and carrying restrictions are scenario scoped.

factsEvidence: At game end, a player controls a Supply Box only if one of their Models is carrying it.
reviews.caveat: Controlling a scenario Supply Box does not create another object identity; it only defines when an existing objective scores.

reviews.summaryEvidence: A Short Skill used by Specialist Troops to Hack a Console.
factsEvidence: The Specialist Troop must be in Silhouette contact with a Console.
A successful unopposed [[attribute:wip]] Roll Hacks the Console.
reviews.caveat: Hack Consoles changes the state/owner of an existing scenario Console; it creates no new console or Army equipment delivery edge.

reviews.summaryEvidence: Activate Disco Ball is a Short Skill (Attack) for reactivating a deployed allied Disco Ball.
factsEvidence: The deployed Disco Ball must be allied and in LoF or [[trait:zone-of-control-zc|Zone of Control]].
An enemy Disco Ball cannot be activated.
reviews.caveat: Activate Disco Ball interacts with the already reviewed Disco Baller source-mode deployed Disco Ball. It does not introduce a second source Weapon, new Ball identity, or another placement path.
